title: The oldest light's snapshot
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The cosmic microwave background comes from an early period roughly 380,000 years after the Big Bang, when the universe cooled enough for light to travel much more freely.

misconception: A learner may choose: At the formation of Earth
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Approximately when was the cosmic microwave background released?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Approximately when was the cosmic microwave background released? About 380,000 years after the Big Bang. The cosmic microwave background comes from an early period roughly 380,000 years after the Big Bang, when the universe cooled enough for light to travel much more freely.
